title: Mass localization for a current vanishing away from a compact set (step 4(a))
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U, V, C ⊆ ℝ^P with C compact, V open and C ⊆ V, and let X ∈ 𝒟_k(U) satisfy X(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) whose topological support is disjoint from C. Then M_G(X) ≤ M_V(X) for every set G ⊆ ℝ^P (M_G = SimonGMT massOn with the Euclidean coefficient norm).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U V C : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsCompact C → IsOpen V → C ⊆ V → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) C → X ω = 0) → ∀ G : Set (Euclid P), X.massOn G ≤ X.massOn V
